fact: Financial Regulatory Authority board decision 186 of 2024 (28 August 2024, amended 28 January 2025) obliges non-bank financial firms to check customers' national number and phone ownership through the Authority's electronic link.
title: قرار مجلس إدارة الهيئة رقم (186) لسنة 2024 بشأن الالتزام بالاستعلام عن صحة بيانات العملاء
why_not: off-topic: a financial regulator's KYC decision under the fintech law, not a rule made under an identity law
